messages:
Mira: Heads-up, I opened a small PR that consolidates tool-calling examples and adds a compact migration snippet from the old function_call usage to the new tools array. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/820

Sam: Nice. Can you scope it to one Node example (streaming) and one Python example (sync + iterator)? Trying to keep the docs minimal.

Mira: Yep thats the plan. Also adding a tiny JSON schema example that shows an array-of-unions case and a short fallback note.

Alex: For parsing guidance, add a one-sentence rule: "if JSON parse fails, try a tolerant extractor that looks for JSON-like substrings, then coerce string elements into objects where the schema expects them." Link to parse runbook.

Priya: I found a stale link in the old docs that points to /tooling/functions. I'll replace with /tool-calling/overview. Also the demo image was 404; removing it.

Sam: Pushed Node + Python snippets to the branch. Node uses the streaming helper and an env var placeholder for the API key. Python includes an example iterator and a comment about token-cost. Ran example lint: one minor typo fixed.

Mira: I patched the broken link and removed the image. Added a migration diff block showing before/after payloads.

Priya: Quick nit: add a single human-readable sentence under the compact schema so folks don't skip it. Also note nullable array items and recommend coercion rule.

Alex: Done. I also suggested a tiny test harness note: run examples against a stubbed tool endpoint as a smoke test.

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-820 (status: success)  anchors render, snippets highlighted.

Mira: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll merge this afternoon. Any last calls?

Sam: LGTM from SDK side.

Priya: +1, merged from my side.

Mira: Merging now.

docs-bot: PR #820 merged by Mira into main (commit: d9a7c6b). Release note: docs: streamline tool-calling examples, add migration snippet, parsing fallback guidance.

Mira: Follow-up TODO: snapshot examples into eval harness and add basic integration smoke check. Will file an issue for that.
